trigger_conditions.condition: Using a requires_grad tensor in torch.einsum and reusing or modifying the tensor before backward, causing autograd graph inconsistency during gradient computation.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: A tensor with requires_grad=True is used as an operand in torch.einsum and then reused in another differentiable operation before backward, causing autograd to detect an in-place modification.

failure_behavior.description: A tensor with requires_grad=True is used as an operand in torch.einsum and then reused in another differentiable operation before backward, causing autograd to detect an in-place modification.
